identificationModule.briefTitle: Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of ASC40 in Subjects With Moderate to Severe Acne Vulgaris
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Multi-center, Multi-dose Study to Evaluate Safety and Efficacy of ASC40 Tablets in Subjects With Moderate to Severe Acne Vulgaris.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a phase2, randomized, double-blind, multi-center, multi-dose and placebo parallel controlled design. The subjects in the study group were given double-blind drugs, and they were taken (orally) after dinner every day according to the requirements of clinical trial scheme.

interventions.name: ASC40 25mg
interventions.description: 25mg of ASC40 orally once daily for 12 weeks.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage change of total lesion count compared with baseline and week 12.
Ratio of subjects, whose IGA grades was decreased by ≥2 grades compared with baseline at week 12.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The changes status and changes of average percentage of inflammatory skin lesions count, non-inflammatory skin lesions count and total skin lesions count compared with baseline.
